rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice when something blocks, impedes, or prevents an action or process.

example.english: Heavy rain can hinder us from reaching our destination.
example.traditional: 大雨會阻住我哋去目的地。
example.jyutping: daai6 jyu5 wui5 zo2 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 muk6 dik1 dei6

rows.note: Use this specifically when the hindrance slows progress, development, or an activity rather than completely stopping it.

example.english: Too many meetings hinder the project's progress.
example.traditional: 太多會議拖慢咗個項目進度。
example.jyutping: taai3 do1 wui6 ji5 to1 maan6 zo2 go3 hong6 muk6 zeon3 dou6

rows.note: Use this when someone deliberately stops or prevents another person from doing something.

example.english: The security guard tried to hinder him from rushing into the venue.
example.jyutping: bou2 on1 zo2 zi2 keoi5 cung1 jap6 wui2 coeng4
